# proxmox_node_journal (Data Source)

Reads node journal lines from `GET /nodes/{node}/journal`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_journal" "recent" {
  node  = "pve-1"
  limit = 20
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node.

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Maximum entries, default 100.
- `service` (String) Only entries of this service.
- `since` (String) Lower time bound.
- `until` (String) Upper time bound.

### Read-Only

- `lines` (List of String)
